query:
UPDATE tenants t
            SET tier = $2::text::account_tier,
                delivered_retention_days = $3,
                dlq_retention_days = $4
            FROM paddle_customers c
            WHERE c.paddle_customer_id = $1
              AND (t.id = c.tenant_id
                   OR (c.tenant_id IS NULL
                       AND c.email <> ''
                       AND t.email = c.email))
